Scripted referential audit, all clean:
- 10 users, 3 jobs and 16 applications have unique ids, and the users have unique emails.
- Every job's recruiter_id resolves to a recruiter and every manager_id to a hiring_manager.
- Every application's job_id and stage resolve. No (job, lower-cased email) pair repeats. Noor appearing on both JOB-PLAT and JOB-DSGN is allowed by hireops_rules.md:34-35.
- Every application with a candidate-account email carries that account's name.
- Positions are contiguous 1..n for each (job, stage).
- Interview occupancy is 2/3, 1/2 and 1/3, within the limits (hireops_rules.md:64). The interview_limit values 3, 2 and 3 lie in 1..50.
- The only REJECTED card, APP-301, has rejected_from SCREEN (a valid non-Hired stage) and a non-blank reason. No card outside Rejected carries reject fields.
- The candidate_status_labels keys equal the stages and match the table at hireops_rules.md:190-197. thread_page_size 30 matches hireops_rules.md:150.
- Messages: 127 rows across APP-101 (120), APP-201 (3), APP-301 (3) and APP-302 (1). Every application_id and sender_id resolves, timestamps strictly increase within each thread, and no body is blank. Every sender may write in that thread under hireops_rules.md:136-140: a recruiter, or the candidate whose email owns the application.
- Notes: 3. Each author is a recruiter or the job's own manager (MGR1 on JOB-PLAT, MGR3 on JOB-DSGN).
- Reads: 6. Every reader has access to the thread, and every read_count is at most the thread length.

Notes (non-blocking, no grading impact):
(a) Two read markers sit below the reader's own latest message. USR-CAN1 on APP-101 has read_count 119, but message 120 is hers. USR-REC3 on APP-301 has read_count 2, but message 3 is his. A live app following 'sending a message counts as reading' (hireops_rules.md:159) would never produce this state. Every observable value is the same either way, though. Own messages are never unread (hireops_rules.md:158), so both readers have 0 unread, and seen status depends only on the other side's marker. A conforming app that applies the stated rules shows the quoted values. Only an app that ignores 'sent by anyone else' and computes total minus read_count shows 1, and that is a real defect, not a seed artefact.
(b) Narrative only: APP-301 is rejected from Screen, yet USR-REC3's 29 July message says 'We will write again once the panel has met'. No criterion depends on this.

- No conforming app fails because of the seed. An alternative app that loads the seed per the public rules reproduces every quoted seeded fact.
